shared_or_similar_visual_information: A filled region selected by a comparison with a plotted boundary. On the left, use the gray region above the curve labeled f, with the visible text “epi f.” On the right, use the gray half-plane to the right of the descending dashed line through the origin.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It represents the epigraph, the coordinate pairs on or above f. Right image: It marks the open solution half-plane of a strict linear inequality.
Rationales: The shaded side identifies locations where the relevant comparison holds in each panel. The plotted boundary and its convention determine how equality is treated in each individual problem.
